title: PostgreSQL: verify-ca refuses a self-signed server certificate

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: PostgreSQL 17.11, self-hosted, DBR 18.3

symptom: INGESTION_GATEWAY_CONNECTION_ERROR.TLS_CONNECTION_FAILURE with the verify-ca SSL mode and a self-signed server certificate.
cause: The certificate isn't trusted by the gateway.
effect: The connection fails; no snapshot runs.
fix: Set trustServerCertificate to true in the connection options, or use a certificate from a CA.
notes: One run logged a TLS connection while pg_stat_ssl showed ssl=false for the gateway's sessions. Not resolved.
